After closing, announcement for visitors
Please give it some attention
Urgent notice for travelers

Travelers must check with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure so pet papers, carrier checks, and care plans are in order. Aurelia Skyways is ready to help, but any missing item can delay boarding and create stress for animals.

The passenger coordinator will review what each pet needs and explain the next steps in plain words. <<FACT F070>> The cabin team also monitors animals during flight and keeps attention on comfort, calm handling, and species needs. Please bring the right health papers and keep them easy to show at the desk. <<FACT F079>>

If you are traveling with a pet, come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away.
